queries.Core system design: We propose UO-Explai: Unified orbit-based explainability for graph neural networks using graphlet orbits to decompose model and instance predictions into interpretable structural patterns
queries.Orbit Basis Learning: We first preproces: Graphlet orbit basis learning for graph neural network explainability using node embeddings and logistic binary classifiers to predict node membership in 2-5 node graphlet orbits
queries.Model-Level Explanation Generation: We d: Greedy optimization decomposing GNN class weights into linear combinations of graphlet orbit bases to generate model-level explanations with class-orbit scores for node classification
queries.Instance-Level Explanation Generation: W: instance-level GNN explanation decomposing individual node predictions into graphlet orbit contributions and using breadth-first search to find local subgraphs matching high-contributing orbit patterns
queries.Unified expert interface: The unified fr: Unified framework for orbit-based graphlet explanations in graph neural networks where domain experts select interpretable graphlet patterns and receive simultaneous model-level global class patterns and instance-level local prediction explanations.
queries.Dataset selection: We plan to use five s: Evaluation of graph neural network explainability using synthetic graph datasets with known graphlet orbit patterns and real-world protein interaction, LastFM-Asia, and gene network datasets for model-level and instance-level explanations
queries.Synthetic validation: For synthetic data: Synthetic graph node classification experiments with GCN and GIN where classes correspond to known graphlet orbit memberships and explanations are evaluated for recovering ground-truth orbit patterns.
queries.Real-world validation: For real-world da: Evaluate fidelity and sparsity of orbit-based GNN explanations on real-world gene networks, visualizing explanatory subgraphs and assessing alignment with known biological pathways.
queries.Evaluation metrics: We will assess expla: Evaluation metrics for graph neural network explainability measuring explanation sparsity, fidelity, edge recall, and subgraph recall against ground-truth subgraphs and prediction probability changes.
queries.Baseline comparisons: For model-level ex: Comparing model-level and instance-level graph neural network explainability methods for node classification, including D4Explainer, GLGExplainer, GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, TAGE, MixupExplainer, SAME, EIG, and MotifExplainer
queries.Technical implementation: We will implem: PyTorch Geometric implementation of orbit basis learning and class-orbit score learning for unified graph neural network explainability with hyperparameter tuning, baseline comparisons, and statistical significance
